{{Quote|Onderon is in your king's rule, and at the outbreak of the Clone War, he chose to align it with the Separatists.''"<br />"''Our true king has been ''silenced''. The one you recognize is a ''traitor'' and a Separatist minion.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Saw Gerrera, on King Sanjay Rash|<ref name="A War on Two Fronts" />}}
The '''Treaty of Iziz''' was an accord by which [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], under the rule of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Sanjay Rash/Legends|Sanjay Rash]], joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] at the beginning of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].
